statBlock.name: Mummy
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead, lawful evil
statBlock.description: Burial rites tether the spirits of priests, nobles, and champions to their remains. They rise when their tombs are disturbed or when called to fulfill an old duty.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Fist attacks and use Dreadful Glare.
Rotting Fist. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit is cursed. While cursed, it cannot regain HP or restore its HP maximum by finishing a Long Rest. Its HP maximum drops by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the attack dies and crumbles to dust. Remove Curse or comparable magic ends the curse.
Dreadful Glare. Choose a creature the mummy can see within 60 ft. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure, it is Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. Success makes it immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

statBlock.name: Mummy Lord
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead (cleric), lawful evil
statBlock.description: A mummy lord trades its heart for immortality and hides the organ away from its body. From an old palace or temple, it raises servants and pursues plans that can span centuries.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a saving throw, the mummy lord can make it a success.
Magic Resistance. It has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undead Restoration. If destroyed while its heart is intact, it forms a new body with full HP after 24 hours. The body appears in an unoccupied space in its lair. The heart is a Tiny object with AC 17, 10 HP, and immunity to every damage type except fire.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and use Dreadful Glare.
Rotting Fist. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit is cursed. While cursed, it cannot regain HP and gains no benefit from a Long Rest. Its HP maximum drops by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the attack dies and crumbles to dust. Remove Curse or comparable magic ends the curse.
Channel Negative Energy. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 25 (6d6 + 4) necrotic damage.
Dreadful Glare. Choose a creature the mummy lord can see within 60 ft. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On failure, it takes 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage and is Paralyzed until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, the mummy lord casts one listed spell without Material components. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability (save DC 17, spell attack +9).
At will. Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague (level 7).
sections.Reactions: Whirlwind of Sand. When hit by an attack roll, the mummy lord gains +2 AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss. It teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Creatures it chooses and can see within 5 ft. of its destination are Blinded until the end of its next turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature's turn. Recover all uses at the start of the mummy lord's turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Glare. Use Dreadful Glare. The mummy lord can use Glare again at the start of its next turn or later.
Necrotic Strike. Make one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.
Dread Command. Cast Command at level 2 with Wisdom as in Spellcasting (DC 17). The mummy lord can use Dread Command again at the start of its next turn or later.
sections.In its lair: 15,000 XP, 4 uses of Legendary Resistance per day, and 4 Legendary Action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Cursed Fate. When a creature other than the mummy lord or its allies casts a Divination spell within 1 mile of the lair, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure, the spell has no effect and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is spent. The caster keeps the resources it would have spent on the spell.
Soul Drain. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.
Both effects stop immediately if the mummy lord is destroyed or relocates its lair. They resume when it forms a new body through Undead Restoration.

statBlock.name: Flameskull
statBlock.description: The skull of a dead spellcaster flies under its own power and burns with magic. It might watch a necromancer's stronghold or chase an ambition its former self never fulfilled.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. It emits Bright Light for 15 ft. and Dim Light for another 15 ft.
Magic Resistance. It has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undead Restoration. A destroyed flameskull recovers all its HP after 1 hour. Sprinkling Holy Water on the remains or casting Dispel Evil and Good on them prevents the return.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fire Ray attacks.
Fire Ray. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, the flameskull casts one listed spell without Somatic or Material components. Intelligence is its spellcasting ability (save DC 13).
At will. Mage Hand.
1/day. Fireball.
2/day. Magic Missile (level 2).

statBlock.name: Ghast
statBlock.description: A ghast is a foul-smelling corpse that hungers for flesh and the vices it knew in life. Ghasts often lead ghoul packs into crypts to raid the graves.

sections.Traits: Stench. Each creature that starts its turn in a 5-ft. Emanation from the ghast makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On success, it is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A creature other than an Undead makes a DC 10 Constitution save after the hit. On failure, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Ghoul
statBlock.description: Ghouls scavenge graves and hunt in packs through catacombs and ruins. Their claws paralyze prey before they feed.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. A creature other than an Undead or an elf makes a DC 10 Constitution save after the hit. On failure, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Shadow
statBlock.description: A shadow haunts a place it knew in life or a site touched by the Shadowfell. It feeds on the living, and its victims can rise as new shadows.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It moves through gaps as narrow as 1 inch at its usual movement cost.
Sunlight Weakness. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on all D20 Tests.
sections.Actions: Draining Swipe. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage and reduce the target's Strength score by 1d4. If this drops that score to 0, the target dies. A Humanoid slain by the attack rises as a Shadow after 1d4 hours.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

ruleNotes: Draining Swipe leaves the duration of the Strength reduction unspecified.

statBlock.name: Specter
statBlock.description: A specter is an angry spirit drawn to places soaked in grief or cruelty. It drains the vigor of the living for a brief taste of the warmth it has lost.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. It can pass through creatures and objects at the cost of Difficult Terrain movement. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Sunlight Sensitivity. Sunlight gives the specter Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Life Drain. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit loses an equal amount from its HP maximum.
